The '''Storm beast pen''' was an area on [[Malachor V]] where [[Meetra Surik]] fought a [[Storm beast|greater storm beast]] while [[Battle of Malachor|looking for]] [[Kreia|Darth Traya]] in [[3951 BBY]]. This is also where [[Mira]] fought and [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Hanharr]].<ref name="TSL" />
